```artifact
Feature: Prescription and Payment System for Chemists, Labs, and Patients

  Scenario: Chemists and Labs can log into the system to access Prescriptions
    Given the system is self-contained and no data is shared with third parties
    When a Chemist or Lab accesses the system with valid credentials
    Then the system should allow access to the Prescriptions

  Scenario: Patients can log into the system to access Prescriptions
    Given the system is self-contained and no data is shared with third parties
    When a Patient accesses the system with valid credentials
    Then the system should allow access to the Prescriptions

  Scenario: Only emails are sent to Patients including the full prescription and Invoice
    Given a Patient has an active prescription
    When the system processes the prescription
    Then an email should be sent to the Patient containing the full prescription and Invoice

  Scenario Outline: Payment Gateway interface is available with the Hospital
    Given the system supports the current standard Payment Gateway
    When a payment is initiated via the Payment Gateway
    Then the payment should be processed successfully
    Examples:
      | Payment Method |
      | Debit Card     |
      | Credit Card    |
      | Net banking    |

  Scenario: A button is enabled to securely accept payments via Debit/Credit Cards and Net banking
    Given a Patient is on the payment page
    When the Patient selects a payment method from Debit/Credit Cards or Net banking
    Then the payment button should be enabled

  Scenario: The system uses Django 2.0
    Given the system is being developed
    When the development team checks the framework version
    Then the system should be using Django 2.0

  Scenario: The system uses MySQL
    Given the system is being developed
    When the development team checks the database
    Then the system should be using MySQL

  Scenario: The system supports Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Safari
    Given the system is being tested on different browsers
    When the system is accessed via Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, or Safari
    Then the system should function correctly

  Scenario: The system supports operating systems that support the above browsers
    Given the system is being tested on different operating systems
    When the system is accessed via an operating system that supports Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, or Safari
    Then the system should function correctly
```
